destination.name: Taveuni
destination.tagline: Fiji's garden island, with rainforest waterfalls and the 180th meridian
destination.description: Taveuni is a rainforest island known as Fiji's garden island, crossed by the 180th meridian. Trails lead to the Bouma waterfalls, whose lower fall is over 30 m high, along the Lavena Coastal Walk, and up 1,195 m Des Voeux Peak. Lake Tagimaucia, a crater lake at about 830 m, is where the tagimaucia, Fiji's national flower, grows, and it grows only on Taveuni. Offshore, Rainbow Reef in the Somosomo Strait is a 32 km soft-coral reef with over 30 dive sites.
whyVisit: Hike to rainforest waterfalls and pools
Climb to crater lakes and peaks

goodToKnow.title: Carry cash for park fees
goodToKnow.detail: Bouma costs about FJD 50 and the Lavena Coastal Walk about FJD 35, both cash only. Fees have changed over the years, so confirm locally.

goodToKnow.title: Lake Tagimaucia is a long hike
goodToKnow.detail: The guided hike takes about eight hours return, and the tagimaucia flowers from October to December.

goodToKnow.title: Book Waitabu ahead
goodToKnow.detail: Waitabu Marine Park is visited on guided tours that must be arranged in advance, from about FJD 20 to 40 a person.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: {months} suit waterfall hikes and diving the Somosomo Strait. Cyclones can occur Nov to Apr.

taveuni-1.bio: Three waterfalls with swimming pools in Bouma National Heritage Park, the lowest a short, flat walk from the visitor centre.

taveuni-2.bio: Coastal track from Lavena village past white and black sand beaches to a waterfall, about 5 km each way.

taveuni-3.bio: Lookout peak at about 1,195 m with views to Lake Tagimoucia and the Lau Group, reached on foot or by 4WD, with good birdwatching.

taveuni-4.bio: A 32 km soft-coral reef in the Somosomo Strait with over 30 dive sites, including the Great White Wall.

taveuni-5.bio: Community-run no-take reef protected since 1998, visited on guided snorkelling and cultural tours arranged in advance.

taveuni-6.bio: Crater lake at about 830 m above Somosomo, reached by a long guided hike, where Fiji's national flower grows.

taveuni-9.bio: Natural rock slide on a Taveuni stream where visitors swim in cool water and slide down the smooth rock.

taveuni-10.bio: Colonial Romanesque Catholic church on a hill at Wairiki, overlooking the beach of a famed canoe battle against Tongan invaders.
